title: Held-out data registry for Track B and the open-population lane
purpose: The single registry of held-out source years, editions, tables and partitions for every Track B gate and every open-population gate. It is part of B0.2's exposure record (design revision 3, section 5.2, elements 4 and 5). The dynamics coordinator set it up on 2026-10-21. Cite it by path, commit and SHA-256.
rules: A gate registers every source year, edition, table or partition it holds out here before its record freezes.

J's candidate holdouts are registered first, because J is on Track B's critical path. OP0.2 registers its picks for OP12's gate_ssa_totals here before it freezes them, and picks from the years J has not taken.
No unit may be held out by two gates silently. If two entries share a unit, each lists the other's id in disclosed_overlaps, and both gates' registrations name the overlap.
A unit is one source at one reference year, or one edition's table, or one partition. Reference years and publication or interview availability are recorded separately (section 5.2, element 10).

An entry whose gate has scored has status 'used'. Its units are exposure for every later gate and never again an unused holdout (section 5.2: previously inspected outcomes remain regression evidence).
Entries are only appended. A status change is recorded in the entry's history, with its date and reason. Ids never change or get reused.
This registry starts with the uses verified below. It is not yet complete: B0.2's mechanical exposure inventory adds the remaining prior uses before any B0.2 gate record freezes.

status_values.candidate: proposed by a gate's B0.2 or OP0.2 record; not yet frozen
status_values.frozen: fixed in a frozen gate record before that gate's candidates run
status_values.used: scored by a registered gate; exposure for every later gate
status_values.withdrawn: released before use, with the reason recorded
